query:axis_condition_extremum_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible row or column label as a string
query:axis_condition_extremum_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel boxes for the matching cells in the winning row or column

query:axis_cell_extremum_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible row or column label as a string
query:axis_cell_extremum_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel boxes for all candidate cells in the named row or column

query:condition_run_extremum_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible row label as a string
query:condition_run_extremum_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel boxes for the winning consecutive run of cells, from left to right

query:colorbar_above_threshold_cell_coun.answer_hint: set "answer" to the requested cell count as an integer
query:colorbar_above_threshold_cell_coun.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel boxes for all counted cells, in row-major order

query:colorbar_below_threshold_cell_coun.answer_hint: set "answer" to the requested cell count as an integer
query:colorbar_below_threshold_cell_coun.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of [x0,y0,x1,y1] pixel boxes for all counted cells, in row-major order
